fact: On 3 April 2026 the Minister of Digital Economy presented in Libreville the outlines of the future national digitalisation strategy, a framework document with five axes still being finalised, with no calendar yet published; the ministry's 2026 budget is 82 billion FCFA against 32 billion in 2025.
title: Le Gabon prépare une stratégie de transformation numérique autour de cinq axes
